newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer appoints new chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Bayer appoints new chief financial officer.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Bayer AG said on Wednesday that it plans to appoint a new chief financial officer to replace Helmut Loehr, who is retiring this spring.

Werner Wenning, currently head of Corporate Planning and Controlling at Bayer, will join the management board on February 1 and be in charge of the group's finance committee, Bayer's supervisory board agreed at its meeting today.
Wenning joined the company as a commercial apprentice in 1966 and has worked in various divisions in Germany, Spain and South America.
